dialogue.realtalk: Talking? Fine. Sit down first, %1$s — standing conversations always run long.
dialogue.realtalk.checkin.good: Been good. Slept in, skipped a chore, the world kept turning. Suspicious how well that works.
dialogue.realtalk.checkin.rough: Rough, honestly. Even my naps have been tired lately, %1$s. That's how I know.
dialogue.realtalk.day.good: Found the sunny patch by the well and stayed in it. The day arranged itself around me.
dialogue.realtalk.day.rough: Someone expected things of me before noon. The day never recovered.
dialogue.realtalk.work.like: I like the parts between the parts. The leaning, the waiting. Done right, that's most of the job.
dialogue.realtalk.work.hate: The work's fine. It's the doing of it. Every chore would improve with a hammock nearby.
dialogue.realtalk.life.first: My whole life, %1$s? That's a lot of sitting to tell. Luckily I was sitting for most of it. Get comfortable.
dialogue.realtalk.dreams.first: A porch facing the sunset, so the day ends where I'm already sitting. Perfect dream. No walking in it at all.
dialogue.realtalk.fears.first: That I'll doze through the one day that actually mattered. I don't sleep as easy as folks think.
dialogue.realtalk.feelings.first: You're the one visit I don't need a nap to recover from, %1$s. From me, that's poetry.
dialogue.realtalk.deflect.personal: That question needs sitting up straight for, and I barely know you. Come back — I'll save you a spot on the fence.
dialogue.realtalk.deflect.intimate: Some things I only say lying in the grass with someone I trust. We're not that far along. Yet.
dialogue.realtalk.gossip.none: News takes effort to happen, and nobody's bothered. My kind of week.
dialogue.chat: A chat works. It's the one chore you can do sitting down.
